title: DesignSystemIndex
description: Schema for the machine-readable design system index consumed by AI tooling (MCP agents, LLM code generators).

version.description: Semver of the design system. The MCP server serves it as design_system_version (ds-metadata.json).

inventory.description: Exhaustive list of all components in the codebase.

sizes.description: Every size a size prop of the component accepts, across its exports and including sizes borrowed from another component (ToggleGroup takes Toggle's, PaginationLink takes Button's), in the order of the canonical scale. The spec's props tables give each export's own scale. Absent means the component takes no size prop. Enforced against the source by scripts/lint-sizes.ts.

shadcn.description: How the component's API departs from shadcn/ui's, the API models already know (AGENTS.md § 1: the shadcn/ui API is the contract, a divergence is additive and declared). Enforced against the code and shadcn-api.baseline.json by scripts/lint-shadcn-api.ts: every divergence is listed, and every listed one exists.

item.description: The shadcn/ui registry item it derives from, in the style of components.json; null for a component shadcn/ui does not have.

divergences.description: Empty when the API is shadcn/ui's. A component outside shadcn/ui lists one entry, { type: added } with no export.

export.description: The export it concerns; absent for the whole component.

prop.description: The prop it concerns; absent for the export itself.

value.description: The value of a union prop it concerns (size="default" → default).

type.description: added: shadcn/ui does not have it. removed: shadcn/ui has it, this component does not. renamed: this is shadcn/ui's upstream under another name. changed: same name, another element, props type, type or default (upstream says which).

upstream.description: What shadcn/ui has: the former name (renamed); the rendered element, the props type, the prop's type, or its default written = value (changed).

note.description: Why the design system departs from shadcn/ui, and what to write instead.

shadcn.description: The shadcn/ui registry beyond the inventory. Enforced by scripts/lint-shadcn-api.ts against the registry:ui items listed in shadcn-api.baseline.json: each one is in the inventory (shadcn.item) or excluded here, and each exclusion names an upstream item.

excluded.description: shadcn/ui components the design system does not ship. The MCP server answers a request for one with its reason and the component to use instead.

item.description: The shadcn/ui registry item, in the style of components.json.

reason.description: Why the design system does not ship it.

instead.description: The inventory component to use in its place.

composition_rules.description: Rules an AI must follow when composing UI using this design system.

applies_to.description: Components whose spec repeats this rule in its Usage section (scripts/build-spec-choices.ts).

glossary.description: Key terms used in this design system and their precise definitions.
